summary.text: Ross Turner is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 8 in Greenville County, serving since 2013.
His official page lists him as president of The Turner Agency, Inc.

paragraphs.text: Turner was born on May 15, 1964, in Greenville, and earned a B.S. from Clemson University in 1986.
His page lists a Certified Insurance Counselor designation since 1994 and a Greenville's Best and Brightest Under 35 recognition in 1997.
He has served in the Senate since 2013.
His committees are Banking and Insurance, Corrections and Penology, Education, Finance, and Fish, Game and Forestry.
